questions.q: Which element serves as proof that staff have read and understood a policy?
questions.explain: An acknowledgement records awareness and acceptance of the policy. Concept from objective 5.4 (beyond textbooks).

questions.q: Which trainings fall under compliance? (Select all that apply)
questions.explain: The first three are listed in objective 5.4. Rules of engagement belong to testing and third-party management (5.3, 5.5).

questions.q: Match each scenario to the corresponding non-compliance consequence.

pairs.left: Negative press campaign and customer loss
Revocation of authorization to process cards

questions.explain: Distinguish image (reputation), money (financial), agreement (contractual), and accreditation (license).

questions.q: A judicial investigation is opened. Which rule applies to logs normally deleted after 30 days?
questions.explain: A legal hold suspends normal retention: data relevant to the proceeding must be preserved intact.

questions.q: Who determines the purposes and means of processing personal data?
questions.explain: The controller determines the purposes and means; the processor acts on their behalf.

questions.q: A customer requests deletion of their data, with no ongoing legal proceeding. Which right are they exercising?
questions.explain: The right to be forgotten targets erasure. Opt-out refuses processing, correction rectifies data, and legal hold prevents deletion.
